[P2] Update internal OTel type consumers before stripping declarations

`exclusive-views.composed.test.ts` and `otel-plugin.composed.test.ts` in the OTel package import the core's `dist-types` namespaces to type `vi.importActual`. This flag removes `loadConfiguredPlugins` and `createInvocationPluginRunner`, both tagged `@internal`, so their destructuring now produces missing-property errors when typechecking the OTel test sources. The reported builds exclude those tests, and Vitest runs without typechecking, so neither catches this regression. Update these tests to obtain internal types through a test-only source configuration or unstripped test declarations, and verify the OTel test sources typecheck after a clean core build.
